exposure: C. trachomatis infection in pregnant women
N. gonorrhoeae infection in pregnant women
outcome: vertical transmission rate of C. trachomatis
vertical transmission rate of N. gonorrhoeae
cohort: 125 pregnant women attending a hospital in Tehran and their 125 newborns.
finding: The vertical transmission rate of C. trachomatis infection from infected pregnant women to newborns was 18.1%, and neonatal ocular C. trachomatis infection was significantly associated with maternal genital C. trachomatis infection.
mod_finding: The study focused on vertical transmission occurring through the birth canal during vaginal delivery, finding a C. trachomatis transmission rate of 18.1% for those delivered vaginally.
cross-section timing: Endocervical and conjunctival swabs were collected from pregnant women and their newborns within 24 hours after birth.
